robustness_audit.policy: Gate first. Rank eligible candidates by DEV missed, DEV unassigned, then extra DEV cohort worst missed, total missed, total unassigned, then pinned stress worst missed, total missed, total unassigned, stable order. Incomplete cohorts are excluded equally across candidates.
robustness_audit.limitations: Four additional synthetic DEV cases plus four fixed stress cases; leave-one-out is sensitivity, NOT statistical confidence or real-world generalization. DEV case scoring is not a production SLA guarantee.

tie_rule: DEV missed, DEV unassigned, extra DEV cohort worst/total, pinned stress worst/total, stable source order last.
primary: DEV aggregate missed deadlines; lower is better
secondary: DEV unassigned cases; lower is better
scope: Predeclared synthetic DEV + four additional development shifts + four pinned stress scenarios; no 08f leakage or real-customer guarantees.
